data.text: Noah, for python-backend-migration: branch air-quality-stt (e30b437, not on main) adds POST /api/telemetry and GET /api/air-quality in TypeScript (apps/server/src/environment/air.ts plus tests in apps/server/src/air.test.ts; see contract air-quality-api). Please port these two routes into office_api, or tell Anders' agent to do it once your API skeleton has landed. The bridge (forward_telemetry) and apps/speech/stt.py only depend on the HTTP shapes, not on the runtime.
